test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Industrious
solution: The correct answer is '**Indolent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Industrious**' is '**Indolent**'. • **Industrious**: always working hard. (कठोर परिश्रमी, अध्‍यवसायी, उद्यमी) • *Example: He said she was very **industrious** and happy.* • **Indolent**: not wanting to work; lazy. (काम न करनेवाला; आलसी; निष्क्रिय) • *Example: **indolent** students/managers...* **Correct Answer:__** *Indolent.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **President**: the leader of a republic. (राष्‍ट्र का अध्यक्ष, राष्‍ट्रपति) • **Zealous**: using great energy and enthusiasm. (ऊर्जावान या ऊर्जापूर्ण उत्‍साही, उत्‍साहपूर्ण) • **Diligent**: showing care and effort in your work or duties. (परिश्रमी, सावधान और कर्मठ) 166:T6ad, The erroneous part is **'point at'.**
